notes.title: Demo update!The localization function of multi-language translation is realized!
notes.content:
Dear Managers, good day to you all~ Just before the October New Product Festival, we’ve rolled out a major update for the game Demo! You can play it right now!

So, what key updates does the SRPG  UltimateGirls Alters new-demo bring?
1.Main Story Chapter 2 Unlocked!
Following the flow of tokusatsu dramas, after the main characters form a team, we enter an episodic arc where they resolve each member’s past issues one by one…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/96fca97a4fbf77c46fb9db623319fed4e10dd050.png"]

In Chapter 2, Mitsuki will meet her high school friend An'anzi. An'anzi once suffered from school bullying and rumors, but now she works part-time as an influencer, gaining popularity with her looks and fashion sense.

Learning that Mitsuki works at the major internet company INFI-X, An'anzi asks Mitsuki and the protagonist to help her get an interview opportunity with the live-streaming department. However, what happens next…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/0ea9ec2927f603c125405d81a68d7b3aac071c26.png"]

In the end, how will the protagonists deal with the crisis of the monster female executive’s attack? Interested players, add it to your wishlist and give the Demo a try!
2.UI & Scene Optimization + Multi-Language Support!
We’ve given a fresh "renovation" to some scenes (e.g., Combat Studio, Company Lobby)! We’ve also optimized the art design for dialogue boxes, battle UI, and more—now the indicators for incoming enemies are much clearer!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/a09e47f1de74988362885cdc6d3f765892b404e0.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/5f52f368ffa7c15c9fa8cdf931df7f8bc31e89e0.png"]

Additionally, we’ve added multi-language support (English, Japanese, etc.) for interfaces and story text. It’s not perfect yet, but it’s usable!

(Japanese Voice and the Japanese version of the theme song didn’t make it this time, but they will be included in the full release!)


3.Richier Story Presentations!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/e791b83f859099f3871cf23ccad1845406e4f0ff.png"]

The protagonists’ chibi/Q-version characters now have more facial expressions. Combined with elements like standing character art, speech bubbles, and expressive particles, the dialogue in the story is much more vivid~ We’ve also optimized audio and visual quality!


4.Heroines’ Personal Side Stories Unlocked!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/00845151d35ac18a02e87887f569593ba4c25f06.png"]

In Chapter 1, the protagonist already visited each heroine’s dormitory to say hello.

On rest days in subsequent chapters, the protagonist will gradually unlock and freely pursue each heroine’s personal side stories, earning their affection points~

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/fa2605ff2039431c7feef65012556ddb07be9fdc.gif"]

Friendly reminder: When Managers complete all affection side stories for every heroine, you’ll unlock the perfect six-person ending!

Six of us together make Alters!


5.More Side Quests & Free Exploration!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/c444b830835934a8b3929ce30e1cdac8640b2b9a.png"]

In Chapter 2, players will encounter more side quests. There are also more interactive explorable items and NPCs in the scenes!

The streets and alleys of Star City are full of interesting things waiting for Managers to discover!… We won’t go into detail about the additional combat experience and minor optimizations—anyway, welcome to add it to your wishlist and play the Demo!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454961/11bd2ec117f676bf377ff3fdf9b941f85bf2001f.jpg"]

The studio will announce the release date for the full game soon, so stay tuned!

Note: Save data between the old and new Demos is not compatible; you will need to start over. Due to development constraints, Demo save progress cannot be carried over to the full version (as it may cause bugs). We apologize for any inconvenience caused!

Bug reports and suggestions are welcome via comments, email, and other channels!
